attacks.text: Put Koga's Pidgey and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Then search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card not named Koga's Pidgey. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Spontaneous Explosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage and Koga's Weezing does 30 damage to itself; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Surprise
attacks.text: Look at a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

abilities.name: Shock Blast
abilities.text: If Lt. Surge's Electrode is your Active Pokémon and gets damaged (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If tails, this power does 20 damage to each Active Pokémon. This power works even if Lt. Surge's Electrode is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it takes damage.

attacks.name: Power Ball
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Raticate's Double-edge attack's damage (base damage and damage to itself) is doubled.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Lt. Surge's Raticate does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Ice Throw
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Fighting, this attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Misty's Dewgong does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Shadow Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Invigorate
attacks.text: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon in any player's discard pile. Put it onto that player's Bench. Put a number of damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't put a Pokémon on a Bench that's full.)

attacks.name: Pendulum Curse
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Helping Hand
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Remove any number of damage counters from that Pokémon, then draw that many cards.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put a number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon so that its remaining HP are 10.

attacks.name: Magic Darts
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Fire Tail Slap
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charmander. Flip a coin. If tails, discard 1 of those cards.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Blaine's Doduo.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to Blaine's Growlithe. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Pranks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a card from your opponent's discard pile and put it on top of his or her deck.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Hind Kick
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, switch Blaine's Ponyta with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horn Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Call Will-o'-the-wisp
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, if you have a Fire Energy card in your discard pile, put it into your hand.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Tremor
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Toss
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Group Therapy
attacks.text: You and your opponent remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon with damage counters on them.

attacks.name: Pulled Punch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Strange Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused; if tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Poison Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fury Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Giovanni's Machop.

attacks.name: Ancestral Memory
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Giovanni's Magikarp stays in play (even putting Giovanni's Magikarp on the Bench won't let you use it again).

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Cat Fleas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Horn Thrust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Giovanni's Nidoran ♀ does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Retaliation
attacks.text: You can't use this attack unless Giovanni's Nidoran ♂ has 2 or more damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Fast-Acting Poison
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Sludge Grip
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Smelly Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (including your own). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Grasping Vine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Sharp Stinger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Group Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Koga's Zubats you have in play. Before doing damage, you may search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon named Koga's Zubat and put them onto your Bench. (You can't get more cards with this attack than you have room on your Bench.) If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Rattata's Quick Attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Bouncing Ball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Voltorb does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Ink Spurt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (This effect lasts until the Defending Pokémon evolves or is Benched.)

attacks.name: Play Dead
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Misty's Magikarp.

attacks.name: Bubbles
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, you can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: ESP
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, draw a card. If exactly 2 are heads, this attack does 20 damage. If all 3 are heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Misty's Psyduck copies that attack except for its Energy costs. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Misty's Psyduck's type is still Water.)

attacks.name: Frostbite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mirage
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Star Boomerang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, return Misty's Staryu and all cards attached to it to your hand. (Either way, this attack does its damage.)

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: This attack can't be used unless Sabrina's Abra and the Defending Pokémon have the same number of Energy cards attached to them.

attacks.name: Psyscan
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Energy Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Psychic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Return Sabrina's Gastly and all Energy cards attached to it to your hand. (Discard all other cards attached to Sabrina's Gastly.)

abilities.name: Gaseous Form
abilities.text: Sabrina's Gastly gets +10 HP for each Psychic Energy card attached to it. This power works even if Sabrina's Gastly is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Barrier Attack
attacks.text: All damage done by attacks to Sabrina's Porygon during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Random ESP
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does no damage and Sabrina's Psyduck is now Confused.

cards.name: Blaine
rules: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

cards.name: Brock's Protection
rules: Attach Brock's Protection to 1 of your Pokémon with Brock in its name. Energy cards attached to that Pokémon can't be removed by your opponent's attacks or Trainer cards. (This doesn't stop the rest of the attack or Trainer card from working normally.)

cards.name: Chaos Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, he or she flips a coin. If heads, that player plays that card normally. If tails, the player can't play that card. If the card isn't put into play, the player's opponent may use that card instead, if he or she does everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile.

cards.name: Erika's Kindness
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from each Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it. If a Pokémon has just 1 damage counter, remove it.

cards.name: Giovanni
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

cards.name: Giovanni's Last Resort
rules: Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

cards.name: Koga
rules: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan
rules: Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.) Treat that card as a Basic Pokémon as long as it's face down. Flip the card if either player needs to know what it is in order to use an attack, a Pokémon Power, or a Trainer card. Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Pokémon Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack, or is otherwise affected by an attack. At any time during your turn, you may flip the card over. When you flip that card over, if it isn't a Basic Pokémon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

cards.name: Misty's Wish
rules: Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Then, ask your opponent if you may switch that card with 1 of the cards in your hand. If your opponent accepts and if you have any other cards in your hand, switch those cards. If your opponent declines, return the Prize card face down and draw a card.

cards.name: Resistance Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Each Pokémon's Resistance is reduced by 20. (If a Pokémon's Resistance is -30, it becomes -10.)

cards.name: Sabrina
rules: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #2
rules: Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #3
rules: Put a Basic or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of an attack of that card. Your opponent guesses the name of that card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Cinnabar City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Ignore Weakness when a Water Pokémon does damage to a Pokémon with Blaine in its name.

cards.name: Fuchsia City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player may shuffle 1 of his or her Pokémon in play with Koga in its name and any cards attached to it into his or her deck.

cards.name: Koga's Ninja Trick
rules: Attach Koga's Ninja Trick to your Active Pokémon with Koga in its name. If this Pokémon goes to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon (before damage or other effects of attacks).

cards.name: Master Ball
rules: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

cards.name: Max Revive
rules: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Misty's Tears
rules: Discard 1 of the other cards in your hand in order to search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, he or she flips a coin. If tails, put damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put in play (like PlusPower or Mysterious Fossil). You may use that card as if it were in your hand, if you do everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). The card stays in your opponent's discard pile.

cards.name: Saffron City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
As often as each player like during his or her turn (before attacking), that player may return 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to his or her hand.

cards.name: Viridian City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Whenever a Pokémon with Giovanni in its name evolves, its owner removes 2 damage counters from that Pokémon (or 1 if it only has 1).

cards.name: Fervor
rules: Show the top 3 cards of your deck to all players. Put any Fire Energy cards there into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Transparent Walls
rules: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.name: Warp Point
rules: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Fairy Power
attacks.text: Return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Hitmontop by attacks is increased by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Mass Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Jumpluff by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Roast Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Noctowl

abilities.name: Night Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. This power can't be used if Noctowl is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Quagsire

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Raichu.

cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Shell Barricade
abilities.text: As long as Shuckle is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to Shuckle by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Slowking

abilities.name: Second Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 3 cards of that player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Double Return
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Wobbuffet.

cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Acceleration Bolt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Ampharos does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Remove from Ariados the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poisonous Saliva
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Cure Powder
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Exeggutor.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

cards.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch Farfetch'd with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Furret

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Timid Tackle
attacks.text: Granbull does 20 damage to itself. Switch Granbull with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull.

cards.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Sleep Pendulum
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Hypno is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Shot
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

cards.name: Meganium

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Meganium.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Persian

attacks.name: Sharpen Claws
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a card from your opponent's hand without looking.

attacks.name: Sneaky Attack
attacks.text: If Persian has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Pichu is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Pichu by attacks.

attacks.name: Playground
attacks.text: Each player may search his or her deck for as many Basic Pokémon as he or she likes, put them onto his or her Bench, and shuffle his or her deck afterward. (You put your Pokémon on the Bench first.) Pichu is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

cards.name: Smoochum

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks.

attacks.name: Energy Antics
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Sunflora

abilities.name: Sunshine Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Typhlosion

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Typhlosion.

cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Tyrogue is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Tyrogue by attacks.

attacks.name: Mischievous Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Tyrogue is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Weezing

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Super Explosion
attacks.text: Weezing does 90 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness to this damage.

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Blissey

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Blissey does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy attached to Corsola and remove all damage counters from Corsola.

attacks.name: Hyper Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Snowy Present
attacks.text: Draw a card for each Water Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

cards.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Return Dunsparce and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Green Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Igglybuff

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Igglybuff is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Igglybuff by attacks.

attacks.name: Graffiti
attacks.text: Igglybuff is now Asleep. During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Mantine

attacks.name: Group Swim
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

cards.name: Metapod

abilities.name: Green Shield
abilities.text: Each of your Grass Pokémon has no Weakness.

cards.flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Moomoo Squeeze
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Moomoo Milk card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Sleep Drain
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 4 damage counters from Parasect.

cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Offensive Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Skiploom

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Slowbro and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

attacks.name: Madkinesis
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to Slowbro.

cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Cosmic Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Water Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy you chose. Shuffle those cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: RETURN
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may return all Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to your hand.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: FLASH
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Wigglytuff by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Happy Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey.

cards.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Sleep Inducer
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Continuous Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Show Off
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Hoothoot

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch Hoppip with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Mimic
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Static Electricity
attacks.text: Search your deck for a number of Lightning Energy cards up to the number of Mareep in play (both yours and your opponent's) and attach them to Mareep. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

cards.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Double-edge Claw
attacks.text: Paras does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

cards.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Phanpy.

cards.flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Sandshrew by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Sentret

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

cards.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: Spider Web
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Cure Kernels
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Vulpix.

cards.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

cards.name: Wooper

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

Draw 2 cards.

rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and switch it with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Professor Elm's Training Method

cards.name: Professor Oak's New Theory

Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

rules: Double Colorless Energy provides ColorlessColorless Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (While not in play, Rainbow Energy counts as Colorless Energy.)

abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Blissey from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may remove all damage counters from all of your Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy attached to those Pokémon that had any damage counters on them.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: Any damage done to Donphan by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Crunch
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Leaf Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Meganium is affected by a Special Condition.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flare Destroy
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Typhlosion and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Ho-Oh LEGEND.

abilities.name: Sacred Rainbow
abilities.text: All Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Ho-Oh LEGEND.

abilities.name: Sacred Rainbow
abilities.text: All Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Lugia LEGEND.

abilities.name: Ocean Grow
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Lugia LEGEND into play, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach all Energy cards you find there to Lugia LEGEND. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy, Water Energy, and Lightning Energy attached to Lugia LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Lugia LEGEND.

abilities.name: Ocean Grow
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Lugia LEGEND into play, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach all Energy cards you find there to Lugia LEGEND. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy, Water Energy, and Lightning Energy attached to Lugia LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, Gyarados does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

cards.name: Alph Lithograph
rules: Look at your opponent's hand!

cards.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stardust Song
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to Jirachi.

attacks.name: Time Hollow
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Hard Crush
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Mantle Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards.

cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

abilities.name: Psychic Float
abilities.text: If you have any Psychic Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Double Leg Hammer
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Magical Trans
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Mismagius is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Switch Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch Octillery with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ink Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Politoed

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose a Water Pokémon on your Bench and switch it with your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Politoed is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Big Chorus
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Shaymin

abilities.name: Celebration Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy attached to Sudowoodo.

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Remove from Torterra the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

cards.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Paralyze Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Launcher
attacks.text: Return 2 Water Energy attached to Blastoise to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

cards.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

cards.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

cards.name: Floatzel

abilities.name: Water Acceleration
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Floatzel. This power can't be used if Floatzel is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stream Pump
attacks.text: You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, return an Energy card attached to Kingdra to your hand.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Lanturn to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Bulk Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of Lucario's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Heat Acceleration
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Bebop Punch
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

cards.name: Roserade

abilities.name: Energy Signal
abilities.text: When you attach a Grass Energy card or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Roserade during your turn, you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Roserade is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Roserade.

cards.flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Steelix by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Steel Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Torkoal

abilities.name: Hot Snort
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Torkoal from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

cards.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

cards.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Cherrim is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Kakuna and put it onto Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Energy Crane
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Psychic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flare Bonus
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

cards.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

cards.name: Pupitar

abilities.name: Boost Gas
abilities.text: If Pupitar has any Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost of Pupitar is 0.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Pupitar.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

cards.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Crimson Bull
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Tauros is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Tail Code
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Reaction
attacks.text: You may switch Beldum with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Mountain Eater
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Larvitar.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Larvitar does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Mankey.

cards.flavorText: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

cards.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Natu

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch Natu with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Onix

abilities.name: Energy Healer
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to Onix, remove a damage counter from Onix.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: Onix can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

cards.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Double Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Roselia is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Spearow

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Remove 4 damage counters from Spearow. Spearow can't retreat during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

cards.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Teddiursa

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Teddiursa does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Green Call
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Turtwig

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Turtwig.

cards.flavorText: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Vulpix.

cards.flavorText: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Weedle and put it onto Weedle. (This counts as evolving Weedle.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Double Attack
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Discard an Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 4 cards.

rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. Choose as many Energy cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Judge
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.

rules: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Perfect Metal
abilities.text: Steelix can't be affected by any Special Conditions

attacks.text: Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Steelix.

attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Alph Lithograph
rules: Shuffle your deck!

cards.name: Bellossom

abilities.name: Hustle Step
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Bellossom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dance 'til Dawn
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Bellossom is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Solar Suggestion
attacks.text: Move up to 4 damage counters from any of your Pokémon to any of your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Forretress

attacks.name: Mirror Shot
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Everyone Explode Now
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Pineco and Forretress you have in play. This attack does 30 damage to each of your Pineco and Forretress in play.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Ninja Fang
attacks.text: If, before Gliscor does damage, the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it and is then damaged by this attack (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Counterattack
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Fighting Pokémon in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dark Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Magcargo. If you do , this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded.

attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.

attacks.name: Leaf Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Snowstorm
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Nidoking

abilities.name: Pheromone Stamina
abilities.text: Nidoking gets +20 HP for each Nidoqueen you have in play.

attacks.name: Venomous Horn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
