attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Basic Energy cards attached to Heatran. (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Blocking Punch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Lucario by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Striking Kick
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon

cards.flavorText: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

cards.name: Luxray

abilities.name: Intimidating Fang
abilities.text: As long as Luxray is your Active Pokémon, any damage done by an opponent's attack is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Luxray does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

cards.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Triple Nose
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all cover. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to Yanmega.

cards.flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Cherrim

attacks.name: Worry Seed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Cherrim.

cards.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Carnivine. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Carnivine's, this attack does 60 damage instead.

attacks.name: Wring Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Fasten Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Night Maintenance
rules: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: Rare Candy
rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

cards.name: Roseanne's Research
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Chimchar.

cards.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Ghastly Sound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Finger Poke
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Happiny

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Chansey from your hand onto Happiny (this counts as evolving Happiny) and remove all damage counters from Happiny.

attacks.name: Lively
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Riolu

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.text: Riolu can't be Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Dragon Rage
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Jet Sword
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Garchomp and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Dive
attacks.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Water Glow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Remove from Manaphy the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: High Volt
attacks.text: If Raichu evolved from Pikachu during this turn, this attack's base damage is 100 instead of 60.

cards.flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Regigigas

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Rotom

abilities.name: Type Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Rotom's type is Psychic until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium card in your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Super Fast
attacks.text: If you have Pachirisu in play, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Buizel during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Nimble
attacks.text: If you have Turtwig in play, remove from Croagunk the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

cards.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Burrow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Gabite by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Distored Wave
attacks.text: Before doing damage, remove 2 damage counters from the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Lopunny

attacks.name: Jump Kick
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Jazzed
attacks.text: If Lopunny evolved from Buneary during this turn, remove all damage counters from Lopunny.

cards.flavorText: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Berry
attacks.text: If you have Croagunk in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It live atop trees.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

cards.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Dizzy Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Buneary by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Serial Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Sleepy
attacks.text: If you have Piplup in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

cards.name: Gible

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its nests is small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Numb
attacks.text: If Pikachu evolved from Pichu during this turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Sport
attacks.text: If Piplup has less Energy attached to it than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus more 10 more damage.

attacks.name: Wavelet
attacks.text: If you have Buizel in play, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

cards.name: Turtwig

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Turtwig.

attacks.name: Parboil
attacks.text: If you have Chimchar in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Remove from Venusaur the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heat Boiler
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Water Pokémon, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Starmie.

attacks.name: Thrash Tackle
attacks.text: Gyarados does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Skuntank.

cards.name: Mew

attacks.name: Rainbow Wave
attacks.text: Choose a type of Energy other than Colorless attached to Mew. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon of that type (including Benched Pokémon). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

cards.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Bawl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Strange Scent
attacks.text: Each player flips a coin. Each player who gets heads chooses a total of 3 damage counters from among his or her Pokémon and removes them. (If the player's Pokémon have fewer total damage counters than that, he or she removes all of them.)

cards.flavorText: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

cards.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Sharp Teeth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Ledyba.

cards.flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Tempting Eyes
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Butterfree. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Rainbow Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Tentacle Grip
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Tentacruel. For each heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Squirt
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Gentle Song
attacks.text: If Lapras has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Sharpshooter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Grass Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

cards.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Revelation
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

cards.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lick Wounds
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Tongue Stretch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

cards.name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Paradise Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from Vileplume (1 if it only has 1). Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Horrid Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Rampage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Primeape. Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

cards.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 damage.

attacks.name: Mushroom Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Roof Fling
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Struggle Bug
attacks.text: Move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Sharp Blade Quill
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Decidueye-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Feather Arrow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hollow Hunt-GX
attacks.text: Put 3 cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Lurantis-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Flower Supply
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Solar Blade
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chloroscythe-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Tsareena

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Then, discard a card from it.

attacks.name: Trop Kick
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Darkest Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Incineroar-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hustling Strike
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tiger Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Burning Slam-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Double Jet
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Wake-Up Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Headlock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

cards.name: Lapras-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Ice Beam-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Wingull

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. It can't retreat during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Courier
attacks.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Brionne

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

cards.name: Primarina

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Sparkling Aria
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

cards.name: Primarina-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bubble Beat
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Roaring Seas
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Grand Echo-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

cards.name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Cowardice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and return it to your hand. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or on the turn this Pokémon was put into play.

cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Pyukumuku

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Vivid Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Searching Light
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your face-down Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Aqua Spark
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Charjabug

attacks.name: Shocking Jaws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Vikavolt

abilities.name: Strong Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Energy card and a Lightning Energy card and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Electro Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

cards.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Surprise Strike
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk

abilities.name: Power of Alchemy
abilities.text: Each Basic Pokémon in play, in each player's hand, and in each player's discard pile has no Abilities.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Psychic Boom
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

cards.name: Espeon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Divide-GX
attacks.text: Put 10 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Toxapex

abilities.name: Toxic Spikes
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, their new Active Pokémon is Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

cards.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

cards.name: Lunala-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moongeist Beam
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't be healed during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunar Fall-GX
attacks.text: Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Basic Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon-GX. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Makuhita

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

cards.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Push Out
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

cards.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

cards.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

cards.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Rock Artillery
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fighting Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Team Play
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Passimian.

cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Shore Up
attacks.text: Attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

cards.name: Palossand

abilities.name: Wall of Sand
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Absorb Vitality
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate

attacks.name: Evil Orders
attacks.text: Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of your Benched Pokémon and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Endeavor
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Persian

attacks.name: Taunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Claw Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

cards.name: Umbreon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Bullet
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dark Call-GX
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Gnaw Through
attacks.text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

cards.name: Sharpedo

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

cards.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

cards.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: False Accusation
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Obsidian Fang
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio

abilities.name: Tangling Hair
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Dig Under
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

cards.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Metallic Sound
attacks.text: Discard all Special Energy from each Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

cards.name: Solgaleo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Ultra Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sunsteel Strike
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sol Burst-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Fight Back
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee

abilities.name: Curative Pollen
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dratini, a Dragonair, and a Dragonite, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Dragon's Wish
attacks.text: During your next turn, you may attach any number of Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Dragon Wave
attacks.text: Discard a Grass Energy and a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

cards.name: Spearow

attacks.name: Peck Bugs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

cards.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Devastating Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 3 cards.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

cards.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.

cards.name: Tauros-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mad Bull-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Spinda

attacks.name: Teeter Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

cards.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Work Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

cards.name: Herdier

abilities.name: Treasure Hunt
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

cards.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Ferocious Bellow
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 50 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

cards.name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Beak Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Yungoos

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Caterpie

abilities.name: Pupate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod

abilities.name: Emerge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Triple Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom

abilities.name: Irresistible Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent's Bench isn't full, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals their hand. Put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench.

cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Varied Pollen
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose Asleep, Burned, Confused, or Poisoned. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Radar Eyes
attacks.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

attacks.name: Assassin Flight
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shinobi Mastery
attacks.text: If you played Koga's Trap from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Ten-Card Return-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 10 cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell

attacks.name: Burning Venom
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Victreebel

attacks.name: Reactive Poison
attacks.text: This attack does 60 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gastro Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon has no Abilities until the end of your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Chlorowhip
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 2 Grass Energy attached to it, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Grubbin

attacks.name: Electrical Signal
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

cards.name: Kartana

attacks.name: Big Cut
attacks.text: If you have exactly 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: False Swipe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Fire Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage, and this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Grand Flame
attacks.text: Attach 2 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Find Wildfire
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Volcanion

attacks.name: Flare Starter
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you go second and it's your first turn, instead search for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: High-Heat Blast
attacks.text: If you have at least 4 Fire Energy in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Litten

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Litten

attacks.name: Caturday
attacks.text: Draw a card. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

cards.name: Incineroar

abilities.name: Strong Cheer
abilities.text: Your Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Strong Cheer Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

cards.name: Salandit

attacks.name: Grass Fire
attacks.text: Discard a Grass Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle

abilities.name: Roast Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Blacephalon

attacks.name: Blazer
attacks.text: Turn 1 of your face-down Prize cards face up. If it's a Fire Energy card, this attack does 50 more damage. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.)

attacks.name: Fireball Circus
attacks.text: Discard any number of Fire Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle

abilities.name: Solid Shell
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

abilities.name: Solid Shell
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rocket Splash
attacks.text: Shuffle any amount of Water Energy from your Pokémon into your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each card you shuffled into your deck in this way.

attacks.name: Giant Geyser-GX
attacks.text: Attach any number of Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Poliwag

abilities.name: Round ‘n' Round
abilities.text: You can use this Ability only if you go second. Once during your first turn (before your attack), you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Swirly Rush
attacks.text: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl are on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

cards.name: Tentacool

attacks.name: Bubble Jutsu
attacks.text: If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Wicked Tentacles
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon. If you do, put 3 damage counters on the Pokémon you moved the Energy to.

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Three Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads. If all of them are tails, you lose this game.

cards.flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

cards.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Dual Blizzard
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler

attacks.name: Bubble Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen

attacks.name: Elegant Swim
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

cards.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Enhanced Horn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, flip 6 coins instead.

cards.flavorText: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

cards.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Call Forth Cold
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hail Prison
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Afterimage Strike
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Pyukumuku

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Surprise Fist
attacks.text: You and your opponent play Rock-Paper-Scissors. If you win, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Never Give Up
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you have at least 3 more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach all Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Raging Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Electric Trap
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Dedenne-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dedechange
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Tingly Return-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Charjabug

abilities.name: Battery
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Vikavolt or Vikavolt-GX as a Special Energy card. This card provides 2 Lightning Energy only while it's attached to a Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

cards.name: Vikavolt

abilities.name: Stealthy Body
abilities.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Weakness.

attacks.name: Electricannon
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Crushing Claw
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Muk & Alolan Muk-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 8 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Poison Absorption
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 100 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nasty Goo Mix-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If this Pokémon has at least 4 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), put 15 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Heavy Choke
attacks.text: If this Pokémon used Wrap during your last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Venoshock
