attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Crobat

abilities.name: Sound Veil
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

cards.name: Gastly

abilities.name: Swelling Spite
abilities.text: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, search your deck for up to 2 Haunter and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Smog
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Sinister Fog
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Shadow Pain
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in any way you like.

attacks.name: Twilight Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

cards.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Hypnotic Pendulum
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, choose which of your opponent's Benched Pokémon becomes their new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stir the Brain
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

cards.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Foul Odor
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing

abilities.name: Detention Gas
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Splattering Sludge
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Mewtwo

abilities.name: Mind Report
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew

abilities.name: Bench Barrier
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Psypower
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

cards.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Mysterious Message
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand. If you drew any cards in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Espurr

attacks.name: Caturday
attacks.text: Draw a card. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ear Kinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Caturday
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Perplexing Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now Psychic until the end of your next turn. (The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)

cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Marshadow

abilities.name: Resetting Hole
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Red Knuckles
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Marshadow & Machamp-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Acme of Heroism-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), and if it would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their next turn, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

cards.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Continuous Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

cards.name: Diglett

abilities.name: Underground Work
abilities.text: If you discard this Pokémon with the effect of Giovanni's Exile, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

cards.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Home Ground
attacks.text: If you have any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

cards.name: Geodude

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem

attacks.name: Steamroller
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Heavy Slam
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Beat attack's base damage is 80.

cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Assault Boom
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

cards.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Dirty Work
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If you played Giovanni's Exile from your hand during this turn, discard the top 5 cards instead.

cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior

attacks.name: Hefty Cannon
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Ground
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Gligar

abilities.name: Free Flight
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Shinobi Strike
attacks.text: If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Tyrogue

abilities.name: Bratty Kick
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Finishing Combo
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your Hitmonlee used Special Combo during your last turn. This attack does 60 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Crabrawler

attacks.name: Knuckle Blast
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Fight Alone
attacks.text: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 50 more damage for each Pokémon fewer you have in play.

cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Stakataka

abilities.name: Wall of Stone
abilities.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this Pokémon's maximum HP is 200.

attacks.name: Top Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Greninja & Zoroark-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Union-GX
attacks.text: Put 2 in any combination of Darkness Pokémon-GX and Darkness Pokémon-EX from your discard pile onto your Bench. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), attach 2 Energy cards from your discard pile to each Pokémon that you put onto your Bench in this way. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Honchkrow-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Ruler of the Night
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Feather Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Unfair-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard 2 cards from it. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Sharpedo

abilities.name: Greedy Evolution
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Darkness Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Bad Fangs
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

cards.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Building Spite
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 1 damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Anguish Cry
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Sandile

abilities.name: Intimidating Fang
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Grandiose Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon during your next turn (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

cards.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Chomp Chomp Panic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

cards.name: Greninja

attacks.name: Bring Down
attacks.text: The Pokémon that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, is Knocked Out. (If multiple Pokémon are tied, choose one.)

attacks.name: Mist Slash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

cards.name: Malamar

attacks.name: Hypnotic Reign
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may discard a Pokémon you find there and use one of that Pokémon's non-GX attacks as this attack.

attacks.name: Dark Pressure
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

cards.name: Lucario & Melmetal-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Steel Fist
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Full Metal Wall-GX
attacks.text: For the rest of this game, your Metal Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio

abilities.name: Hair Wall
abilities.text: Your Metal Pokémon take 10 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

cards.name: Aron

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Extra-Tight Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Rush Up
attacks.text: If you attached a Pokémon Tool card from your hand to this Pokémon during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Genesect

abilities.name: Fast-Flight Configuration
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Splitting Beam
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Meltan

attacks.name: Steel Melt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Metal Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal

abilities.name: Metal Eater
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Metal Pokémon from your hand. If you do, heal 100 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Gardevoir & Sylveon-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fairy Song
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Fairy Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Kaleidostorm
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Magical Miracle-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Fairy Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Excitable Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, shuffle your hand into your deck and then draw 6 cards. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.flavorText: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Moon-Watching Dance
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Pokémon that has any Fairy Energy attached to it.

cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Orb Polish
attacks.text: Put 3 Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Sleepy Ball
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

cards.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Daunt
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Energy Present
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Fairy Feast
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from each of your Fairy Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fluffy Cotton
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Energy Blow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Toy Box-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Spritzee

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Aromatisse

attacks.name: Pungent Aroma
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is heads, your opponent reveals their hand. For each heads, choose a card you find there. Your opponent shuffles those cards into their deck.

attacks.name: Miraculous Cologne
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

cards.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Escaping Incisors
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

cards.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Drill Run Double
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Caturday
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian

abilities.name: Gathering of Cats
abilities.text: Ignore all Energy in the attack costs of each of your Pokémon in play that has the Caturday attack.

cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Persian-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Cat Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Cat Walk Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Vengeance
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile. You can't add more than 180 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Slash Back-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Double Peck
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

cards.name: Dodrio

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Eat Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool card in this way, heal all damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tonguenado
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Digicharge
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your deck for an Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon2

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

cards.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Crazy Code
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Special Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

cards.name: Rowlet & Alolan Exeggutor-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Super Growth
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Grass Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. If that Pokémon is now a Stage 1 Pokémon, search your deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Calming Hurricane
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tropical Hour-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent shuffles all Energy from all of their Pokémon into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Time Spiral
attacks.text: Devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by removing the highest Stage Evolution card from it. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Sewaddle

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Sewaddle and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Sewaddle

abilities.name: Swaddling Leaves
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Swadloon

abilities.name: Swaddling Leaves
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny

abilities.name: Blanket Weaver
abilities.text: Your Grass Pokémon take 40 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Blanket Weaver Ability at a time.

cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Crustle

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 150 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Karrablast

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Amoonguss

abilities.name: Bursting Spores
abilities.text: Whenever you play a Pokémon that has the Spore attack from your hand during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

cards.name: Lurantis

attacks.name: Petal Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Sol Slice
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached to it, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

cards.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

cards.name: Tsareena

abilities.name: Queenly Reward
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Grass Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

cards.name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Sea Creeper Net
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Smoke Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Smoke Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Strong Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Heatran-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Burning Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Fire Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

attacks.name: Hot Burn-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Victini

attacks.name: Victory Sign
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Spirit Burner
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Pokémon you discarded in this way. Then, put any number of Fire Pokémon you discarded in this way onto your Bench.

cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

cards.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flare Raid
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Slowpoke & Psyduck-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Ditch and Splash
attacks.text: Discard any number of Supporter cards from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Thrilling Times-GX
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage. If this Pokémon has at least 6 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), flip 10 coins instead, and this attack does 100 more damage for each heads. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Lapras

abilities.name: Mermaid's Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put a Misty's Favor card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Froslass

attacks.name: Spiteful Sigh
attacks.text: Put up to 7 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

cards.name: Lumineon

attacks.name: Neon Trickery
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

cards.name: Snover

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow

attacks.name: Quick Freeze
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, it is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

cards.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Swarming Bites
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Basculin you have in play to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

cards.name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Ancient Custom
abilities.text: Pokémon Tool cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon have no effect.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

cards.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Frozen Lock
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Keldeo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Pure Heart
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Resolute Blade-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sticky Web
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more, and its Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Wimpod

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

cards.name: Golisopod

abilities.name: Emergency Exit
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 2 or fewer Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: First Impression
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

cards.name: Pyukumuku

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Tapu Fini

attacks.name: Nature Wave
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Ultra Beasts in play, this attack can be used for Colorless.

cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Raichu & Alolan Raichu-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tandem Shock
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 80 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Ride-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Meal Time
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu

attacks.name: Electro Rain
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. Then, for each Energy you discarded in this way, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and do 30 damage to it. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

cards.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Lightning and Metal type.

attacks.name: Magnetic Bolt
attacks.text: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

cards.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Live Wire
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Also apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Wild River
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Generate Electricity
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Overspark
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross

abilities.name: Electric Swamp
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your hand and you have at least 4 Lightning Energy cards in play, you may play this Pokémon onto your Bench. If you do, move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hover Over
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Trap Bolt
attacks.text: If, before doing damage, your opponent's Active Pokémon has more remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Thunderous Gale
attacks.text: If Tornadus is on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Raging Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tapu Koko

attacks.name: Nature Dive
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, this attack does 100 more damage, and discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

cards.name: Xurkitree

attacks.name: Three Mirrors
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Mewtwo & Mew-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Perfection
abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX on your Bench or in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Miraculous Duo-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Espeon & Deoxys-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psychic Club
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Psychic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cross Division-GX
attacks.text: Put 10 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), put 20 damage counters on them instead. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Full Clean
attacks.text: Discard your hand.

cards.flavorText: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Spirit Smash
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If the card you discarded is a Pokémon, this attack does damage equal to that Pokémon's HP to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

cards.name: Jynx

abilities.name: Ominous Posture
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Attract Smack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Wynaut

abilities.name: Peppy Pick
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.flavorText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

cards.name: Latios-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Bind
abilities.text: If you have 4 or fewer Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Tag Purge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from TAG TEAM Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clear Vision-GX
attacks.text: For the rest of this game, your opponent can't use any GX attacks. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jirachi-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Zone
abilities.text: Don't apply Psychic Weakness when Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take damage from attacks.

attacks.name: Star Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Star Shield-GX
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

cards.name: Drifblim

abilities.name: Tag Transport
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active TAG TEAM Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

cards.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Uxie

abilities.name: Secret Territory
abilities.text: If you have Mesprit and Azelf in play, apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×4 instead.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Mesprit

attacks.name: First Contact
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Azelf

attacks.name: Psypower
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Giratina

abilities.name: Dimension Breach
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

cards.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Luminous Blade
attacks.text: Discard a Psychic Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Munna

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna

attacks.name: Rest Well
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep. During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 100 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

cards.name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Mysterious Noise
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. Your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Lucky Find
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Slashing Cutter
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Slashing Cutter
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

cards.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Durable Blade
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard all cards attached to it.)

attacks.name: Trash Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Item card in your discard pile. You can't do more than 130 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Necrozma

attacks.name: Barrier Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Special Laser
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Poipole

attacks.name: Last Scene
attacks.text: If each player has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 130 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Bedrock Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Ground Stream
attacks.text: Attach 2 Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gigaton Shake
attacks.text: During your next turn, your Pokémon can't attack. (This includes Pokémon that come into play on that turn.)

cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Aerodactyl-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Primal Winds
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Wild Dive-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Turn the Tables
attacks.text: If 1 of your opponent's Pokémon used a GX attack during their last turn, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Pre-Dawn Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Meditite

attacks.name: Spirited Headbutt
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Spirited Headbutt during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Medicham

attacks.name: Pure Power
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Master Strike
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Karate Belt card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

cards.name: Relicanth

attacks.name: Deep Sea Boring
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

cards.name: Garchomp

abilities.name: Avenging Aura
abilities.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Over Slice
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Lucario

abilities.name: Tag Coach
abilities.text: Your TAG TEAM Pokémon take 20 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Rototiller
attacks.text: Shuffle 4 cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Archen

attacks.name: Endeavor
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

cards.name: Archeops

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

cards.name: Terrakion

attacks.name: Cavern Counter
attacks.text: If all of your Benched Pokémon have at least 1 damage counter on them, this attack does 150 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Tag Cheer
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your TAG TEAM Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shooting Star Pirouette
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Zygarde

abilities.name: Cellular Companions
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Zygarde's and Zygarde-GX's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Boost Fang
attacks.text: Attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

cards.name: Umbreon & Darkrai-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Black Lance
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon-GX or Benched Pokémon-EX. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dark Moon-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 5 extra Darkness Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mega Sableye & Tyranitar-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Greedy Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Gigafall-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 5 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), discard the top 15 cards of your opponent's deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shadow Connection
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Darkness Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nocturnal Maneuvers-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Mirror Gem
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Cross Poison
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Cleaning Up
attacks.text: Discard a Pokémon Tool card from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Shadow Scratch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

cards.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Turf Raid
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your remaining Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

cards.name: Yveltal

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.name: Scyther

If you have exactly 6 cards in your hand, this attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

abilities.name: Seasonal Blessings
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Hide and Seek
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Skill Dive
