cards.name: Lunala

attacks.name: Shatter Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage times the amount of Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wings of the Moone
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Machop

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machoke

abilities.name: Daunting Pose
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. Your opponent's attacks and Abilities can't put damage counters on your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Settle the Score
attacks.text: This attack does 80 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took on their last turn.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

abilities.name: Roadblock
abilities.text: Your opponent can't have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. If they have 5 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 4 Pokémon on the Bench. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number.

cards.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Double Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Finishing Stinger
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Nosepass

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Whiscash

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Landslip
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. This attack does 100 damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

cards.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

cards.name: Rockruff

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

cards.name: Lycanroc-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Eyes
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dangerous Rogue-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mudbray

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale

attacks.name: Enhanced Stomp
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: High Horsepower
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Minior

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cosmicsplosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

cards.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Raven's Claw
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Limitation
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

cards.name: Absol

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Doom News
attacks.text: Put all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand. At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

cards.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

cards.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Core Beam
attacks.text: Discard a Metal Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Core Beam
attacks.text: Discard a Metal Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

cards.name: Metagross-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Geotech System
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Psychic or Metal Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer during your next turn.

attacks.name: Algorithm-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

cards.name: Solgaleo

attacks.name: Shining Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fangs of the Sunne
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Fangs of the Sunne during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Lullaby
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Meteor Mash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Meteor Mash attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

cards.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: The Wages of Fluff
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out during your next turn, take 2 more Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

cards.name: Sylveon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Magical Ribbon
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Plea-GX
attacks.text: Put 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to them into your opponent's hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Comfey

abilities.name: Flower Shield
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Fairy Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent draws a card.

cards.flavorText: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

cards.name: Goomy

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If head, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

cards.name: Sliggoo

attacks.name: Division
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Sliggoo and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

cards.name: Goodra

attacks.name: Power Whip
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Beat Slider
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

cards.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Amass
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Jangmo-o

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Kommo-o-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Adamantine Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ultra Uppercut-GX
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

cards.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Fresh Egg
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 80 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

cards.name: Taillow

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Swellow

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Swallow Dive
attacks.text: If this Pokémon used Agility during your last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

cards.name: Castform

attacks.name: Weather Teller
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

cards.name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Turbo Storm
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Glance
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Scrutinize
attacks.text: Look at the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck, discard 1 of them, and put the other card back.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

cards.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

cards.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Loop-the-Loop
attacks.text: Put all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear

abilities.name: Rake It In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Dangerous Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Komala

abilities.name: Comatose
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever you attach an Energy from your hand to it, it is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Hypno Roll
attacks.text: This attack can be used if this Pokémon is Asleep. If it is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Max Potion

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Rare Candy

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Shed Skin
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Bye-Bye Heal
attacks.text: Heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Stinky Scent
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Disgusting Pollen
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Downer Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crosswise Whip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

cards.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

cards.name: Heracross

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage

attacks.name: Leaf Supply
attacks.text: You may attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Bubble Net
attacks.text: Energy can't be attached to the Defending Pokémon from your opponent's hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Wimpod

abilities.name: Wimp Out
abilities.text: During your first turn, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

attacks.name: Armor Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Crossing Cut-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Flare Recharge
attacks.text: Attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Odor Sleuth
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Salazzle-GX

attacks.name: Queen's Haze-GX
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Turtonator

attacks.name: Flame Cloak
attacks.text: Attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales

abilities.name: Luminous Barrier
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Brine
attacks.text: This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tornado Shot
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Venting Anger
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Magikarp in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Splash Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Aqua Reflect
attacks.text: Move a Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Gnash Teeth
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Synchronoise
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that shares a type with your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu

abilities.name: Evoshock
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Thunder Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Aqua Shock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Small Appetite
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon's maximum HP is 100 or more, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Vacuum Bolt
attacks.text: You may do 80 more damage. If you do, this attack does 80 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Electrosmash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Drift Ashore
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Unarmed
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, ignore all Energy in this attack's cost.

cards.flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Shadowy Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Seviper

abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.text: Put 1 more damage counter on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Dark Guidance
attacks.text: Put a Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Night Roam
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Dark Invitation
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench, and put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Boost
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove that Special Condition from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

cards.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Steamroller
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Espurr

attacks.name: Perplexing Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now Psychic until the end of your next turn. (The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)

cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Hand Kinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.

cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

cards.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Absorb Life
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

cards.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dust Storm
attacks.text: Discard all cards from both Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

cards.name: Necrozma-GX

abilities.name: Light's End
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Colorless Pokémon.

attacks.name: Prismatic Burst
attacks.text: Discard all Psychic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Black Ray-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Machamp-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

attacks.name: Muscle Punch-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior

abilities.name: Toppling Wind
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone

abilities.name: Heal Block
abilities.text: If you have Solrock in play, Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Solar Heat
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

cards.name: Lucario

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Quick Guard
attacks.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. This Pokémon can't use Quick Guard during your next turn.

attacks.name: Brick Break
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance or any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

cards.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Gutsy Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself for each damage counter on it.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Dangerous Claws
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

cards.name: Mudbray

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Kakuna and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Sudden Sting
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Kakuna during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Cacnea

attacks.name: Sucker Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

cards.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Hunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Shell On
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Shelmet from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Grass Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Horn Leech
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Dance of Flames
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to your opponent's Pokémon, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

cards.name: Starmie

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

cards.name: Magikarp

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Waterfall Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Draconic Disaster
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Dread Storm-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 90 damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Forceful Tackle
attacks.text: You may put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Ink Spit
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Special Artillery
attacks.text: You may discard a Special Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Double Claws
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

cards.name: Milotic

attacks.name: TLC
attacks.text: Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Ocean Cyclone
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Regice

abilities.name: Iceberg Shield
abilities.text: If you have Regirock in play, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Stage 2 Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

cards.name: Shellos

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Pika Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Alolan Golem-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Super Electromagnetic Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Heavy Rock-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Energy Catch
attacks.text: Put 3 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Gnawing Curse
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

cards.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Chaos Wheel
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Dark Arts
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Grumpig

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Confused.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Bell of Silence
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon that has an Ability from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Pumpkin Bomb
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Salandit

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Fixer of the Forest
attacks.text: Put 3 Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

cards.name: Nihilego-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Empty Light
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Symbiont-GX
attacks.text: Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Lucha Fight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

cards.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

cards.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Rock Peak Growl
abilities.text: Your Registeel's attacks do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Tough Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Gastrodon

attacks.name: Eerie Fluid
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's non-Fire Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Buzzwole-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Absorption-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Puncturing Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Deino

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Weed Out
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 3 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, discard your other Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Destruction
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Revenge Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Buster Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Registeel

attacks.name: Turbo Arm
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Iron Hand
attacks.text: If Regice is on your Bench, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Kartana-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Slice Off
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gale Blade
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Blade-GX
attacks.text: Take a Prize card. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Punishing Slap
attacks.text: If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any Darkness Energy attached to them, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

cards.name: Xerneas

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Bright Horns
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tropical Head
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dragon Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Tower-Go-Round-GX
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o

attacks.name: Noble Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Kommo-o

attacks.name: War Cry
attacks.text: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Clanging Scales
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

cards.name: Miltank

abilities.name: Moomoo Malt
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Draco Melody
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Dragon Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Starly

attacks.name: Bug Search
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Hunting
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by the damage from this attack, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

cards.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Seal of Antiquity
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless Regirock, Regice, and Registeel are on your Bench.

attacks.name: Giant Stomp
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Seal of Antiquity
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless Regirock, Regice, and Registeel are on your Bench.

attacks.name: Giant Stomp
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Amazing Plea
attacks.text: Choose 2 cards from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put them into your hand. If yes, put those cards into your hand. If no, this attack does 80 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Type: Null

attacks.name: Armor Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Silvally-GX

cards.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Quick Dive

attacks.name: Royal Blades

cards.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Poison Jab

attacks.text: If you have exactly 7 cards in your hand, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Tyrunt

attacks.name: Crunch

attacks.name: Peace Maker
attacks.text: If your opponent has an Ultra Beast in play, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

attacks.name: Calm Strike

attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
