abilities.name: Charmed Charm
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Pokémon Tool card that has "Fairy Charm" in its name from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

cards.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Tapu Fini

attacks.name: Dream Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Wonder Shine
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Healing Pirouette
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sympathetic Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

cards.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Happiness Supplement
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Powerful Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Almighty Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put any Stage 1 card from your hand onto this Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or the turn this Pokémon was put into play.

cards.flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Enhanced Horns
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Stunning Likeness
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may use the effect of a Supporter card you find there as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Milk Cannon
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Moomoo Milk cards in your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

cards.flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

cards.name: Lugia-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pelagic Blade
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Pelagic Blade during your next turn.

attacks.name: Lost Purge-GX
attacks.text: Put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Kecleon

abilities.name: Unit Color 1
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy GrassFireWater attached to it, it is a Grass, Fire, and Water Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tongue Smack
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Kecleon

abilities.name: Unit Color 3
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy FightingDarknessFairy attached to it, it is a Fighting, Darkness, and Fairy Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Celebi & Venusaur-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pollen Hazard
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Evergreen-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Grass Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), shuffle all cards from your discard pile into your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna

abilities.name: Grass Cushion
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Grass Energy attached to it, it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Destiny Stinger
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if this Pokémon has any damage counters on it. Both Active Pokémon are Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Parasect

abilities.name: Panic Spores
abilities.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Confused Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Grip and Squeeze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Guillotine Hug
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

cards.name: Shaymin ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Flower Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Reprisal
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Roaring Resolve
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 2 Fire Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Continuous Blaze Ball
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Nine Temptations
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 2 Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

cards.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Top Burner
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon. Then, discard a card from the top of your opponent's deck for each Energy you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Litten

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

cards.name: Squirtle

abilities.name: Floating Shell
abilities.text: If you have a Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Powerful Squall
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Water Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Hydro Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Headache
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Swim
attacks.text: If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any Water Energy attached to them, you may do 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon instead of their Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Enter the Dragon
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card that evolves from this Pokémon from your discard pile onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Distilled Blast
attacks.text: Reveal the top 7 cards of your deck. This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Water Energy you find there. Then, shuffle those Energy cards back into your deck and discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Articuno

abilities.name: Blizzard Veil
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched Water Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cold Cyclone
attacks.text: Move 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Blitz
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Tag Bolt-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Smash Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

cards.name: Alolan Golem

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Bomb
attacks.text: Move any number of Lightning Energy from your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each Energy card you moved in this way.

attacks.name: Super Zap Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode

abilities.name: Electro Shaker
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunderous Assault
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 70 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Power Recharge
attacks.text: Put all Electropower cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Impact Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electrical-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 7 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Delivery Dash
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Electropower cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Blitzle during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga

abilities.name: Nuzzly Gathering
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Pokémon that has the Nuzzle attack, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

cards.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spider Thread
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Tapu Koko ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Dance of the Ancients
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon and attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Gengar & Mimikyu-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

attacks.name: Horror House-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), each player draws cards until they have 7 cards in their hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Family Rescue
attacks.text: Shuffle 5 Psychic Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

cards.name: Nidoqueen

abilities.name: Queen's Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Power Lariat
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Evolution Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: King's Drum
attacks.text: If Nidoqueen is on your Bench, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

cards.name: Tentacool

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Void Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Paranormal
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Ultra Beasts.

cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

cards.name: Muk

abilities.name: Poison Sacs
abilities.text: The Special Condition Poisoned is not removed when your opponent's Pokémon evolve or devolve.

attacks.name: Toxic Secretion
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Limbo Limbo
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Alolan Club
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has Alolan in its name.

cards.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Strange Wave
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Water and Psychic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Scoop-Up Block
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon that have any damage counters on them, and any cards attached to those Pokémon, can't be put into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mr. Mime-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Magic Odds
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks if that damage is exactly 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, 130, 150, 170, 190, 210, 230, or 250.

attacks.name: Breakdown
attacks.text: For each card in your opponent's hand, put 1 damage counter on their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Life Trick-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Dazzle Dance
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Mysterious Dance
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Cosmog

abilities.name: Cosmic Guard
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

cards.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

cards.flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Special Combo
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your Hitmonchan used Hit and Run during your last turn. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Hit and Run
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Omanyte

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

cards.name: Omastar

abilities.name: Fossil Bind
abilities.text: As long as you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

cards.flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

cards.name: Kabuto

attacks.name: Ramming Shell
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

cards.name: Kabutops

abilities.name: Fossilized Memories
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Chip Away
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Payback
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Arm Thrust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Lycanroc-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Twilight Eyes
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Splintered Shards-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy card in your opponent's discard pile. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Chemical Breath
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk

abilities.name: Adventurous Appetite
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 6 cards of your opponent's deck and discard any number of Item cards you find there. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck.

attacks.name: Gunk Shot
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bite Off
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-GX or a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Poochyena

attacks.name: Howl in the Dark
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Dark Fang
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol

abilities.name: Dark Ambition
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, its Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Shadow Seeker
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

cards.name: Spiritomb

attacks.name: Spirit Compressor
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 4 Pokémon and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Hide in Shadows
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Taunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Night Punishment
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile. You can't do more than 200 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

cards.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Trash Crash
attacks.text: Discard an Item card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

cards.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Yveltal

attacks.name: Derail
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Hoopa-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rogue Ring
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dark Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Dark Strike during your next turn.

attacks.name: Devilish Hands-GX
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 30 damage to it. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Incineroar-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Scar Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crushing Punch
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Darkest Tornado-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Calm Strike
attacks.text: If you have used your GX attack, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

cards.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stellar Wish
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck, reveal a Trainer card you find there, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle the other cards back into your deck, and this Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Bronzor

abilities.name: Evolutionary Advantage
abilities.text: If you go second, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn.

cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shady Stamp
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Ferroseed

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Thorn Pod Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. You can't do more than 100 damage to a Benched Pokémon in this way. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Single Lunge
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Cobalion-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metal Symbol
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dueling Saber
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Iron Rule-GX
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, their Pokémon can't attack. (This includes Pokémon that come into play on that turn.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Cut Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Tool Drop
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool card attached to all Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Royal Guard
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shield Bash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Klefki

abilities.name: Key of Secrets
abilities.text: Each of your Metal Pokémon's Resistance is now -40.

cards.flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales

abilities.name: Luminous Barrier
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Filch
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Copycat
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon used an attack that isn't a GX attack during their last turn, use it as this attack.

cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Latias & Latios-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Buster Purge
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aero Unit-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to it during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor

attacks.name: Tropical Shake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each type of basic Energy card in your discard pile. You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor

attacks.name: Paradise Draw
attacks.text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand. Then, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Egg Splat
attacks.text: Discard any number of Exeggcute from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Dragon Rage
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini

abilities.name: Defensive Scales
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite

abilities.name: Fast Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Eevee & Snorlax-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cheer Up
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dump Truck Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Megaton Friends-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), draw cards until you have 10 cards in your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto

abilities.name: Air Mail
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

cards.flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spin Storm
attacks.text: Your opponent puts their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their hand.

cards.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian

attacks.name: Make 'Em Pay
attacks.text: If your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand, they reveal their hand. Discard cards you find there until your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand.

attacks.name: Sharp Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Tool Buster
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool card in this way, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Fast Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Herd
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your Tauros and Tauros-GX.

cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Aerodactyl

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Fossil Fangs
attacks.text: If you don't have any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Power Charger
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Zangoose

attacks.name: Head Hunt
attacks.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal any number of Pokémon you find there, and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Bill's Analysis
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 Trainer cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Black Market ◇
rules: When a Darkness Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) that has any Darkness Energy attached to it is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card.
Whenever any player plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Stadium card.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

cards.name: Brock's Grit
rules: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Buff Padding
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to has a Retreat Cost of exactly 4, it gets +50 HP.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Dana
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon.
Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Dangerous Drill
rules: You can play this card only if you discard a Darkness Pokémon from your hand.
Discard a Pokémon Tool or Special Energy card from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon, or discard any Stadium card in play.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Electrocharger
rules: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, shuffle an Electropower card from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Erika's Hospitality
rules: You can play this card only if you have 4 or fewer other cards in your hand.
Draw a card for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Evelyn
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 1 Pokémon.
Draw 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Fairy Charm UB
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
Prevent all damage done to the Fairy Pokémon this card is attached to by attacks from your opponent's Ultra Beast Pokémon-GX and Ultra Beast Pokémon-EX.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Grass Memory
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Silvally-GX this card is attached to is a Grass Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Ingo & Emmet
rules:
Look at the top card of your deck, and then choose 1:
• Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
• Discard your hand and draw 5 cards from the bottom of your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Jasmine
rules: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you go second and it's your first turn, search for 5 Metal Pokémon instead of 1. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Judge Whistle
rules:
Choose 1:
• Draw a card
• Put a Judge card from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Lavender Town
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may have their opponent reveal their hand.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Metal Goggles
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

The Metal Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and your opponent's attacks and Abilities can't put damage counters on it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Morgan
rules: You can play this card only if you discard Dana, Evelyn, and Nita from your hand.
Look at the top 12 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nanu
rules: Choose a Basic Darkness Pokémon in your discard pile. Switch it with 1 of your Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nita
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon.
Put an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon on top of their deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Communication
rules: Reveal a Pokémon from your hand and put it into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Communication
rules: Reveal a Pokémon from your hand and put it into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Communication
rules: Reveal a Pokémon from your hand and put it into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Return Label
rules: Put a card from your opponent's discard pile on the bottom of their deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Sabrina's Suggestion
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Unidentified Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Colorless Basic Pokémon. At any time during your turn (before your attack), you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Viridian Forest
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a card from their hand. If they do, that player searches their deck for a basic Energy card, reveals it, and puts it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Water Memory
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Silvally-GX this card is attached to is a Water Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxicroak

cards.name: Galarian Meowth

cards.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Cufant

abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed.)

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Leap Out
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Big Storm
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium in play.

cards.flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

cards.name: Wingull

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

cards.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Milotic V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Spiral Attack
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

cards.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Twirling Sign
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

cards.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Resonance
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka

attacks.name: Ice Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Headbutt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.

cards.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

cards.name: Inteleon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Snipe Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Report
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.name: Inteleon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hydro Snipe
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

attacks.name: Max Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda

attacks.name: Spiral Jet
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. If you don't, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Eiscue

abilities.name: Ice Face
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 60 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

cards.name: Eiscue V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Cold Absorption
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, heal 30 damage from it.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Voltorb

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Orb Collector
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Electrified Bolt
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Shinx

attacks.name: Under Pressure
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio

abilities.name: Top Entry
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you drew this Pokémon from your deck at the beginning of your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench.

cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Luxio during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Helioptile

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

cards.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Eerie Impulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

cards.name: Charjabug

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt

attacks.name: Powerful Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt Beam
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

cards.name: Boltund V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Electrify
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Bolt Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Lightning Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

cards.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Poison Shout
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

cards.name: Toxtricity V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Electric Riot
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.name: Toxtricity VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Riot
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Pincurchin V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Counterattack Kerzap
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Shining Fingers
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable

abilities.name: Prankish
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon on top of their deck.

cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Natu

attacks.name: Me First
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

cards.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Energy Warp
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola

abilities.name: Perish Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

cards.name: Sigilyph

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

cards.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sand Sink
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If this Pokémon has a Cursed Shovel attached, discard 2 more cards from the top of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Super Absorption
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

cards.name: Hatenna

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Hattrem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brutal Swing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

cards.name: Hatterene

abilities.name: Mind Hat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Each player discards a card from their hand. (Your opponent discards first.)

attacks.name: Dripping Grudge
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

cards.name: Milcery

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

cards.name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Decorate
attacks.text: Attach any number of basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Indeedee

attacks.name: Replenish Time
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Drakloak

attacks.name: Summon
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dreepy and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Phantom Force
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Dragapult V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Assault
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Dragapult VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Phantom
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

attacks.name: Meteor Assault
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.

cards.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Meditite

attacks.name: Yoga Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham

attacks.name: Yoga Kick
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Barboach
